WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=%(p)s AND m.shared_input_record_id=%(r)s AND m.profile_sha256=%(h)s AND m.source_id=ANY(%(scope)s) AND d.completed) SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,ts_rank_cd(lexical,websearch_to_tsquery(CASE language WHEN 'en' THEN 'english'::regconfig WHEN 'ru' THEN 'russian'::regconfig ELSE 'simple'::regconfig END,%(lexical_query)s)) AS score FROM permitted WHERE lexical @@ websearch_to_tsquery(CASE language WHEN 'en' THEN 'english'::regconfig WHEN 'ru' THEN 'russian'::regconfig ELSE 'simple'::regconfig END,%(lexical_query)s) ORDER BY score DESC,source_id,start_offset LIMIT %(limit)s

WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=%(p)s AND m.shared_input_record_id=%(r)s AND m.profile_sha256=%(h)s AND m.source_id=ANY(%(scope)s) AND d.completed) SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,((strpos(' '||phrase_text||' ',%(phrase)s)>0)::int + (SELECT count(*)::float FROM unnest(CAST(%(entities)s AS text[])) AS e(term) WHERE e.term=ANY(exact_terms))/GREATEST(cardinality(CAST(%(entities)s AS text[])),1)) AS score FROM permitted WHERE strpos(' '||phrase_text||' ',%(phrase)s)>0 OR exact_terms && CAST(%(entities)s AS text[]) ORDER BY score DESC,source_id,start_offset LIMIT %(limit)s
